name: Aktse-Pårte
estimatedTime: 7-9 hours per STF overview; 8-10 hours per STF detailed stage and Naturkartan
description: Aktse to Pårte. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Suobbatjåhkkå natural water crossing: Natural surface-water crossing near bridge cluster. Treat/filter/boil; do not imply tested potable water.
notes: Route geometry is land-only candidate linework. The Aktse-Laitaure crossing and short hut/landing approach are intentionally kept as transfer/access context rather than invented hiking linework.

STF overview says 22 km / 7-9 h; STF detailed stage says 22 km / 8-10 h; Naturkartan says 23.0 km / 8-10 h; STF Aktse facility text says Pårte is about 24 km south; route apps vary around 19.6-22.6 km.
Naturkartan official GPX/API is about 19.66 km and starts/ends between Pårte and Laitaure south, excluding both Laitaure crossing and the boardwalk from Aktse hut.
Naturkartan/OSM shared Pårte trail endpoint is about 110 m from STF Pårte hut coordinate.
STF names the halfway shelter Rittak, while Naturkartan/OSM use Jågge. Evidence indicates the same rest-shelter cluster.
Official-source/rules lanes observed boat page updated 2025-05-07; transit lane observed 2025-07-05. All agree it is 2025/until-further-notice information.
OSM maps a waste-disposal node near Jågge/Rittak, but Länsstyrelsen says it has no mountain waste management and visitors must carry out what they bring.

facilities.name: STF Aktse Mountain Cabin
facilities.coordinateSource: STF official GPS coordinates; OSM node 339303441 cross-check
facilities.description: Remote STF start hut with lodging, guest kitchen, sauna, limited shop/resupply and seasonal staffing. Official facility page says Aktse is outside the Sarek boundary.
facilities.routeProximity: official section start; on OSM full-stage endpoint cluster

facilities.name: STF Aktse shop / resupply
facilities.description: Limited mountain-cabin shop/service at Aktse, not a full grocery. Availability follows hut staffing/opening.

facilities.name: Emergency phone, STF Aktse
facilities.description: Emergency phone point in the Aktse hut cluster.
facilities.routeProximity: start hut compound, about 26 m from OSM route line

facilities.name: Aktse tenting/service-fee camping
facilities.description: Tenting near STF cabin, with hut-service fee if using hut facilities. STF recommends tents at least 150 m from buildings when not using services.

facilities.name: Laitaure south landing

facilities.name: Raststuga Laitaure

facilities.name: Laitaure dry toilet

facilities.name: Jågge / Rittak rest shelter
facilities.description: Rest shelter roughly halfway between Laitaure and Pårte. Name discrepancy: STF says Rittak; Naturkartan/OSM say Jågge.

facilities.name: Jågge / Rittak dry toilet

facilities.routeProximity: on-route shelter cluster, about chainage 13.90 km

facilities.name: Emergency phone, STF Pårte

facilities.description: Tenting near Pårte hut is not bookable; service fee applies for use of hut facilities. Camp farther away if not using services.
